headline: Black Hills Corp Stock Reaches 52-Week High of $78.78
summary: Shares of electric and natural gas utility Black Hills Corp rose to $78.78, marking a new 52-week high.
why: Black Hills Corp is a US utility holding company delivering electric and natural gas service across eight states.

impacts.name: Black Hills Corp
impacts.why: Stock advanced to touch a new 52-week high price of $78.78.

why_moved: Black Hills Corp stock traded up to reach a 52-week peak of $78.78.
